mapper.sql:
SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.phone, u.email, u.status, u.user_type, u.last_login_time, u.last_login_ip, u.created_at, COALESCE(u.department_id, ud_first.min_dept_id) AS department_id, COALESCE(d_main.name, d_first.name) AS department_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.role_name ORDER BY r.id SEPARATOR ',') AS role_names, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.id ORDER BY r.id SEPARATOR ',') AS role_ids FROM rbac_user u LEFT JOIN rbac_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN rbac_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id LEFT JOIN rbac_department d_main ON d_main.id = u.department_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, MIN(department_id) AS min_dept_id FROM rbac_user_department GROUP BY user_id ) ud_first ON ud_first.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN rbac_department d_first ON d_first.id = ud_first.min_dept_id WHERE u.deleted = 0
AND u.username != 'developer'
AND (u.username LIKE #{keyword} OR u.nickname LIKE #{keyword} OR u.phone LIKE #{keyword})
AND COALESCE(u.department_id, ud_first.min_dept_id) IN
#{did}
GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY u.id DESC
